classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class for managing orders in Opencart, including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval of order data, products, totals, subscriptions, and histories.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order record in the database with provided data, including products and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order record, merging new data with existing, and manages related products, totals, and subscriptions.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the status ID of a specific order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with an order.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and associated data such as products, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about an order, including products, totals, and related data.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to an order, including options and subscription details.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes all products and related options and subscriptions from an order.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products within an order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a product in an order.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options associated with an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Creates a subscription record linked to an order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes subscription records associated with an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details for an order product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts total orders linked to a specific subscription.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Adds a total record to an order.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes total records from an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total records for an order.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for an order, handling status changes, fraud checks, stock updates, and affiliate commissions.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries for an order.
